subject: Eye of Malroth
text: Defeating the disguised enemies opens a path to a treasure chest in Malroth's Cavern containing the Eye of Malroth.

evidence.quote: When you defeat them, you'll be able to walk right into the next room, and then up to a treasure chest that contains the EYE OF MALROTH.

subject: Dragon's Bane
text: The treasure chest on the far side of a lava lake in Malroth's Cavern contains the Dragon's Bane.

evidence.quote: That chest contains the DRAGON'S BANE.

subject: 154 gold
text: A treasure chest in the long hallway past the staircase in Malroth's Cavern contains 154 gold.

evidence.quote: chest contains 154 GOLD.

subject: First chest in long hallway
text: The first treasure chest in the long hallway of Malroth's Cavern is a poison trap and contains no items.

evidence.quote: Note that the first of ... is a poison trap.  It doesn't contain any items.

subject: Red door
text: The red door in Malroth's Cavern opens with the Golden Key.

evidence.quote: Now you'll see a red door, which you can open with the golden key.

subject: Malroth's Cavern lava
text: The path through Malroth's Cavern requires walking on lava the entire time.

evidence.quote: Yes, you must walk across lava the whole time.

subject: Dragon's Bane
text: Dragon's Bane costs 640 gold, resists status ailments, and is used by Hero, Prince, and Princess.

evidence.quote: | Dragon's Bane          |   640  | Resist status ailments        | H,B,G   |

subject: Eye of Malroth
text: The Eye of Malroth shows the entrance to Rhone and is used by Hero, Prince, and Princess.

evidence.quote: | Eye of Malroth         |     -  | See the entrance to Rhone     | H,B,G   |

subject: Cave to Rhone
text: The Cave to Rhone is revealed by stepping through the Beran House of Healing portal, crossing the swamp to its third patch from the left on the top row, and using the Eye of Malroth on the mountain.

evidence.quote: town of Beran, where you should stay at the inn, then save your progress. ... Once you've done so, go to the town House of Healing and stand in front of ... the black space at the back.  Cast the stepguard spell, then use the Jailer's ... Key to open a gate.  Pass through and step onto the portal.  Climb the stairs ... there to exit the monolith, then head west through the forest and over the ... plains, to the edge of a swamp.  Cross partway over the swamp, so that you ... stand on the third patch from the left on the top row.  Face the mountain ... there and use the Eye of Malroth.  The mountain will split to reveal the Cave ... to Rhone.

subject: Cave to Rhone
text: Characters should be around level 25 before entering the Cave to Rhone.

evidence.quote: should first have your characters at somewhere around level 25.

subject: Cave to Rhone
object: Wing of the wyvern and leaf from the World Tree
text: Bring a wing of the wyvern to return to Beran if the prince falls, and a fresh leaf from the World Tree.

evidence.quote: Be sure to bring along a wing of the wyvern, ... just so you can easily return to Beran if your prince should happen to fall ... It also wouldn't hurt to be carrying a fresh leaf from the World Tree.

subject: Horks
text: Horks are numerous in the stairs chamber of the Cave to Rhone and guard the Life Crest.

evidence.quote: As you'll find, these zombified beasts are thicker than flies on manure in this particular portion of the cave. It's ironic, as the undead beasts are guarding the item you most want, the LIFE CREST.

subject: Horks
text: Firebane magic can damage all Horks, even when split into separate groups, while Infernos is too weak to help.

evidence.quote: taking them out with firebane magic, which will potentially do damage to all ... of them (even if they're split into separate groups), but the infernos spell ... seems too weak to be of much use.

subject: Life Crest
text: The Life Crest is in a treasure chest near the lower right corner of the Horks' chamber in the Cave to Rhone.

evidence.quote: It's located in a treasure chest near the lower right corner of the chamber.

subject: Rubiss's magic
text: Only Rubiss's magic can counter Hargon's optical illusion at his tower.

evidence.quote: only the magic of that wizard can counter the optical illusion

subject: Life Crest
text: The Life Crest is a legendary crest used by Hero, Prince, and Princess.

evidence.quote: | Life Crest             |     -  | Legendary crest               | H,B,G   |

subject: One-tile portal
text: The one-tile portal to the Chamber of Rubiss is reached from Midenhall by sailing west about twelve tiles, then heading due south.

evidence.quote: Chamber of Rubiss is to head to Midenhall, then sail west about twelve tiles ... before heading due south.

subject: Chamber of Rubiss
text: No special requirements are needed to enter the Chamber of Rubiss.

evidence.quote: There are no special requirements to enter it, surprisingly.

subject: Charm of Rubiss
text: Standing on the center blank tile of the Chamber of Rubiss makes Rubiss appear and bring the Charm of Rubiss.

evidence.quote: When you stand there, the wizard Rubiss will come to greet you. ... an item known as the CHARM OF RUBISS.

subject: Charm of Rubiss
text: With the Charm of Rubiss you have the strength to tackle Hargon.

evidence.quote: With the charm in your possession, you now have the ... strength (you hope) to tackle Hargon.

subject: Charm of Rubiss
text: Charm of Rubiss gives protection from an enchanter and is listed as used by H,G,M.

evidence.quote: | Charm of Rubiss        |     -  | Protection from an enchanter  | H,G,M   |

subject: Beran House of Healing portal
object: Forest east of Cave to Rhone
text: The waiting portal from Beran's House of Healing leads to a forest just east of the Cave to Rhone.

evidence.quote: The waiting portal will take you to a patch of ... forest just to the east of the cave.

subject: Cave to Rhone
text: Characters should be around level 25 or so before attempting the Cave to Rhone.

evidence.quote: you should be around level 25 or so before attempting

subject: Cave to Rhone four-way passage
text: The four-way passage repeats unless followed in order: left into the multi-branch passage, down the third branch from the right, straight down two more screens, then up a staircase.

evidence.quote: You're now at the center of a four-way passage. ... so follow them in this precise order: left into a passageway with multiple branches, down the third branch from the right, straight down two more screens and up a staircase.

subject: Lottery Ticket
text: A passage leading up off the winding corridor, before the right-hand room, holds a treasure chest with a Lottery Ticket.

evidence.quote: leads up to find a treasure chest with a LOTTERY TICKET.

subject: Armor of Erdrick
text: A treasure chest to the right of the staircase in the Cave to Rhone contains the Armor of Erdrick, the most powerful defensive equipment in the game.

evidence.quote: Climb it and you'll see a ... treasure chest to your right.
This contains the ARMOR OF ERDRICK, which is ... the most powerful defensive equipment available in the game.

subject: Beran
text: Warp back to Beran to save before re-attempting the Cave to Rhone; levels and the Armor of Erdrick are kept.

evidence.quote: I would recommend warping back to Beran so that you can save your progress ... before re-attempting the cave.
have gained, and of course your newly-acquired armor.

subject: Old man
text: The old man on the twisting lava path is actually two evil clowns.

evidence.quote: It seems the old man was actually two evil clowns.
